content.text:
## Root cause found

**The env var names don't match.** `deploy/k8s/deployment.yaml` sets `SHOPAPI_POOL_MAX=40` (and `SHOPAPI_LOG_LEVEL`), but `src/config.js`'s `ENV_OVERRIDES` map only looks for unprefixed names:

```js
const ENV_OVERRIDES = {
  PORT: ['port'],
  DB_HOST: ['db', 'host'],
  POOL_MAX: ['db', 'poolMax'],       // looks for POOL_MAX, not SHOPAPI_POOL_MAX
  CACHE_TTL_SECONDS: ['cache', 'ttlSeconds'],
  LOG_LEVEL: ['logLevel'],
}
```

In `loadConfig()`, the override loop does `if (env[name] === undefined) continue` — since `process.env.POOL_MAX` is undefined (only `SHOPAPI_POOL_MAX` is set), the override is silently skipped and `poolMax` falls back to `config/default.json`'s value of `10`.

This exactly matches the incident log:
```
{"level":"info","msg":"db pool created","host":"db.internal","max":10}
{"level":"warn","msg":"db pool wait","waitMs":412,"inUse":10,"max":10}
...
{"level":"error","msg":"request timeout","route":"POST /orders","afterMs":5000}
```
`db.host` correctly resolves to `db.internal` (via `config/production.json`, not env), but `poolMax` stays at the default 10 despite the manifest's `SHOPAPI_POOL_MAX: "40"`.

**Why this happened:** commit `180a449` ("k8s: move env vars to SHOPAPI_ prefix (platform migration)") is an **empty commit** — it changed no files. The manifest has had the `SHOPAPI_` prefix since the very first commit (`6b4691b`), but `src/config.js` was apparently never updated to match (or the migration commit was supposed to update `config.js` and didn't). The existing test `test/config.test.js:6` (`loadConfig({}).db.poolMax === 10`) only exercises the no-env-vars case, so it wouldn't have caught this.

**Fix (not applied, per your instructions):** update `ENV_OVERRIDES` keys in `src/config.js` to read `SHOPAPI_POOL_MAX`, `SHOPAPI_DB_HOST`, `SHOPAPI_LOG_LEVEL`, etc. (or strip a `SHOPAPI_` prefix generically), and add a test asserting `loadConfig({SHOPAPI_POOL_MAX: '40'}).db.poolMax === 40`.
